newsitem.title: USA: Access Beyond's Rose to resign as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Access Beyond's Rose to resign as CFO.

text.p: Access Beyond Inc said on Thursday Richard Rose would step down as chief financial officer and it named Mark Fields acting CFO.

Fields had served under Rose for about six months at the company's predecessor, Pentril DataCom Networks Inc, it said. From 1990 to 1996 he was vice president of finance and administration for Dynatech Communications Inc, it said.

The company also said it named John Perkins vice president of product management. Before joining the company, Perkins held various positions with Network Equipment Technologies Inc, Access Beyond said.
It was not immediately available to comment on why Rose left. He had been with the company for nine years.
